---
title: "Analyzing NBA Recruits"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
recruits <- read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx")

tibble(
  column = names(recruits),
  type = map_chr(recruits, \(x) paste(class(x), collapse = ", ")),
  examples = map_chr(recruits, \(x) paste(head(as.character(x), 3), collapse = ", "))
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
summary(recruits |> select(rank, nba_mean_ws48, top_mean_wa, total_seasons, drafted))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| cache: true
basketball_tibble <- recruits |>
  mutate(
    tier = factor(
      tier,
      levels = c("Never played", "Brief career", "Solid career", "All-Star level", "Superstar"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    recruit_group = factor(
      recruit_group,
      levels = c("#1–10", "#11–25", "#26–50", "#51–100", "Outside top 100"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
plot_data <- basketball_tibble |>
  filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, color = tier)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "gray35",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(
      plot_data,
      name %in% c("LeBron James", "Draymond Green", "James Harden", "Kawhi Leonard")
    ),
    aes(label = name),
    color = "black",
    nudge_y = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    x = "Recruit rank",
    y = "Peak Wins Added",
    color = "Career tier"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
